source: Actual production WorkerHost computations with a local queue adapter. Developer calibration, not student learning results or a supplied checkpoint.
objective: Expected fixed-start discounted return; primary score mean discounted frozen-softmax evaluation return.

scenario.description: Deterministic movement; stochastic learned actor. Position is the complete task state.

prediction.answer: Developer calibration prediction, recorded before computation: compare actual discounted returns; no assumed winner.
